Available quantity ignores click-and-collect warehouse stock when browsing from a specific country
When I view a product page for a country where a collection point warehouse carries the item, the available quantity shown is lower than expected — it doesn't include stock at that pickup location. If I switch to a region with no country filter, the same product shows higher availability including the collection point's inventory. I expected click-and-collect warehouses to count toward available quantity regardless of which country I'm browsing from.

Loading warehouses by shipping zone crashes with an undefined name error
When I query for warehouses associated with a shipping zone, the request fails immediately with a name resolution error. The same pattern works fine when loading warehouses by channel, but this one never succeeds. I expected to get back a list of warehouses linked to the given shipping zone.

Local pickup stock hidden when browsing by country
When a customer filters product availability by country, the reported stock count excludes items available at click-and-collect warehouses. This makes products appear less available than they actually are for local pickup in that region.

Translating a promotion clears its link to the original sale
When I create a translation for a promotion that was migrated from an old sale, the promotion loses its old sale ID. The discount reason then shows as "Promotion" instead of "Sale", and the connection to the original sale is gone. This only happens after running a translation mutation, not when creating or updating the promotion itself.

Promotion translation fails when providing description as a string
When translating a promotion's description by passing it as a plain text value, the mutation rejects the input or stores corrupted data. Other entity translations (products, categories, vouchers) accept the description as a simple string, but promotions require a different format. I expected the promotion translation to work the same way as all other translations in the system.

Stock quantity not updated in memory after increasing
When I use the stock increase method to add inventory, reading the quantity field right afterward still shows the old value instead of the new total. The database gets updated correctly, but the instance itself doesn't reflect the change until I reload it from the database.

Inventory count doesn't update after reducing stock
After reducing stock for a product, the remaining quantity doesn't show the correct number. I was processing an order and expected the inventory count to reflect the reduced amount immediately.

App responsible for export event hidden behind wrong permission check
When viewing which app performed an export event, the system verifies whether the requesting staff member is the same person who carried out the export, rather than checking if they have permissions to manage apps. A staff member with app management privileges can be blocked from seeing which app ran an export they did not personally initiate.

Export events appear out of chronological order
When I view the history of an export file, the events are not displayed in the order they actually occurred. They seem to follow database insertion order rather than the timestamps on each event. I expected the log to show events in the sequence they happened.

Expected behavior: Events should be ordered by their recorded date/time so the history reads chronologically.

Export event message sometimes missing
When viewing the history log of an exported file, some events show no message even though the API guarantees every event has one. This happens for older export records where the event data was created before certain fields were added. I expected all events in the export history to always display a message.

Automatic checkout completion activates when enable flag is omitted
When I update checkout settings and provide the automatic completion configuration block without specifying the enable flag, the system turns on automatic completion anyway and applies default delay and cutoff date values. I expected that omitting the enable flag would leave the existing setting unchanged rather than activating it.

Checkout auto-completion only affects newly created orders
Enabling automatic checkout completion without specifying a cut-off date causes only checkouts created at the exact moment of saving to be auto-completed. Existing checkouts are ignored. I expected the feature to apply to all eligible checkouts.

Automatic completion delay resets to default when updating other settings
When I update checkout settings to change the automatic completion cutoff date while keeping automatic completion enabled, the delay gets reset to the system default even though I didn't specify a new delay. I expected only the cutoff date to change while my existing delay setting would be preserved.

Promotion rule names shown in wrong language
When I add products to my cart on the multilingual store, some promotion/discount rule names appear in the wrong language. For example, I'm browsing in English but see a Spanish discount name applied to my item. This happens especially when the same product variant is in my cart multiple times or across different items. I expected all promotion rule names to match my selected language.

Promotion rules returned for wrong checkout lines when some variants lack channel listings
When fetching promotion rule information for multiple checkout lines, the returned rules can be associated with the wrong lines if some variant-channel combinations do not have channel listings. The loader pairs promotion rules with language codes based on a simple zip that does not account for gaps caused by missing channel listings, causing misalignment between results and the original request keys.

Message and external URL updates ignored on webhook retry
When a payment provider sends a webhook for an already-processed transaction event with a new message or external URL, those updated values are silently dropped and the original values are kept. For example, if the first webhook had an empty message and the provider retries with a descriptive message, the message stays empty. I expected the latest details from the provider to overwrite the existing ones.

Refund success doesn't update order refund status
After reporting a successful refund from my payment provider, the order's refund status stays as pending even though the money was returned. The refund request that was created earlier in the system isn't being matched to the success report, so the order never shows the refund as completed.

Wrong error code when auto-calculated amount cannot be determined
When reporting a transaction event where the amount should be auto-calculated from prior events (such as a failed authorization or refund reverse), if there are not enough previous events to calculate the amount, the API returns an error with code "required" even though the amount field is actually optional for that event type. The error message correctly explains the calculation failure, but the error code is misleading and suggests the user must provide an amount when they shouldn't need to.

Numeric search ignores promotion names
When I search for sales using a number like 50, results only match promotions whose discount amount equals that number. Promotions with the number in their title, like a fifty percent off sale, don't appear unless the discount value happens to be exactly that number.

Filtering by discount type shows mixed results
When I filter vouchers by "fixed" or "percentage" discount type, the results include shipping vouchers that happen to use the same discount value format. For example, selecting "fixed" shows both regular fixed-amount vouchers and shipping vouchers with a fixed discount amount. I expected each discount type filter to show only vouchers of that type.

Voucher times used count is inflated when combined with other filters
When I filter vouchers by the number of times used, the usage counts appear higher than they should be. This happens particularly when I combine the times used filter with other filters like status or date range. I expected the count to accurately reflect the actual number of redemptions for each voucher.

Fewer variant attributes returned than the limit allows when filtering by selection
When I query a product variant's attributes with both a limit and a variant selection filter, I get fewer results than the limit specifies. For example, requesting three visible-in-variant attributes returns only two because non-matching attributes are counted against the limit before being filtered out. I expected the limit to apply only to attributes that actually match the selection criteria.

Sync event errors display confusing message format
When a sync event fails, the error output mixes the human-readable message with an error code in an unexpected way. The message appears alongside extra data that makes it hard to quickly identify what went wrong from logs or error reports.

Circular subscription sync errors crash when reading error code
When a circular subscription sync error occurs, any handler that tries to read the error's code attribute crashes with an attribute error. All other error types in the system expose a code attribute for programmatic handling, but this one doesn't. I expected to be able to inspect the error code the same way as other exceptions.

Missing line IDs in checkout error
When modifying a checkout with invalid items, the error just says checkout lines don't exist without specifying which ones. I have to search through my request data to figure out which line IDs were rejected.

Reordering product variants doesn't persist
When I reorder product variants through the admin interface, the new order briefly appears but reverts back after I refresh the page. I select the variants I want to reorder, drag them into the desired sequence, save the changes, and the mutation returns successfully. However, reloading the product page shows the original ordering. I expected the variants to stay in the order I set.

Variant reorder doesn't save
I reordered product variants using the GraphQL mutation, but after refreshing the page the variants went back to their original order. The mutation returned successfully with no errors, so I expected the changes to be persisted.

Cannot cancel fulfillment when order contains gift cards elsewhere
I'm trying to cancel a fulfillment for physical items, but the system rejects it because the same order also has a gift card fulfillment. I expected to be able to cancel just the non-gift-card fulfillment independently.

Items not restocked when canceling pending approval fulfillment
When I cancel a fulfillment that is still waiting for approval, the products are removed from the fulfilled count but never returned to my warehouse inventory. I selected a specific warehouse for the restock, but the stock levels did not change after the cancellation. I expected the items to be returned to the warehouse I chose.

Generic error for already-canceled fulfillment
Attempting to cancel a fulfillment that is already canceled shows a vague message that it cannot be canceled, without explaining it has already been canceled. I expected a clearer message indicating the fulfillment is already canceled.

Reserved quantity shows as a decimal instead of a whole number
When I check the reserved quantity for a product at a warehouse, it sometimes appears as a decimal like 10.0 or 12.500000000000002 instead of a clean integer. I expected the reserved quantity to always display as a whole number since items are counted in units.

Company name persists after warehouse deletion
When I delete a warehouse and query its details, the company name field still returns a value from the associated address record. Other address-related fields in the same response handle this case differently and return null. I expected all derived address data to be cleared when the warehouse is removed.

Product variant channel context missing from stock queries
When I query stock information and request the associated product variant, the variant's channel slug is always null, making it impossible to determine which channel the variant belongs to.

JSON concatenation fails during batch updates
When I use the JSON concatenation feature to batch-update multiple records, the operation sometimes fails with a database error about missing parameters. Individual record updates work fine, which suggests the issue is specific to how the expression is compiled for bulk operations.

JSON concatenation ignores NULL values for complex expressions
The helper converts NULL database values to empty JSON objects when using simple field references, but when I use a computed expression or function on either side, NULL values pass through and break the update.

JSON concatenation silently drops data on NULL fields
When I bulk-update a model's JSON field using the custom concatenation expression, records with NULL in that field don't get merged correctly — they stay NULL instead of having new keys inserted. The docs say NULL values should be treated as empty JSON, but it only works when the left side is a simple field reference. If I pass any other kind of expression that could evaluate to NULL, the null-handling logic doesn't kick in.

Category label disappears on type subclasses
I defined a base GraphQL type with a documentation category tag, then created a subclass that extends it with additional fields. When I check the schema output, the subclass shows no category even though the parent type has one assigned. I expected the category to carry through to all subclasses automatically.

Product export filter exports everything instead of filtered set
When I select the filter option while exporting products, the resulting CSV contains all products instead of just the ones matching my filter criteria. I applied a price range filter before starting the export, expecting only those products to be included.

Deprecated tax field still selectable when exporting products
I can still choose 'charge taxes' as one of the fields to include in a product export, even though it has been marked as deprecated. The exported CSV contains a column with no meaningful data. I expected this option to be hidden or at least flagged as deprecated so I wouldn't waste time on it.

Staff access restored after login restriction
When password-based authentication is restricted to customers only, users who previously held staff privileges still regain them after logging in. The system strips staff access during authentication but then overwrites it based on the stored token data. I expected my account to remain limited to customer-level access once the restriction was enabled.

Permission checks fail for specific objects
When I try to perform an action on a particular resource like editing a single order or updating one product, the system denies access even though my account clearly has the relevant permissions for those operations at a general level. The same permissions work fine when checking globally, but as soon as the check is scoped to a specific object, it returns nothing.

Expected: permissions should be evaluated against the specific object, not silently dropped.

Cannot retrieve user by ID after login
After authenticating via JWT, any operation that looks up the user by their numeric ID silently fails and returns no user. The authentication backend's user retrieval method interprets the user ID as an email address instead of a database identifier, so lookups using the standard numeric user ID always produce no results.

Shipping tax rate stuck after changing method
When I change the shipping method on an existing order to a different one with a different tax rate, the displayed shipping tax rate does not update and still shows the old method's rate. The shipping method name and price change correctly, but the percentage stays the same as before. I expected the tax rate to reflect whichever shipping method is currently selected.

Payment failure shows raw gateway error to customer
When a payment fails during checkout, the error message shown to the customer is the raw error from the payment gateway. It includes technical details and internal codes that don't help the customer understand what went wrong.

Order shipping address doesn't update after saving changes
When I edit an order and change its shipping address, the new address appears to be saved. But after refreshing the page, the order still shows the old shipping address. The same happens with the billing address.

Payment webhook rejects valid tokenization results
When submitting a webhook payload for payment method tokenization, the system rejects some valid result values with a generic validation error. The result field should accept all supported tokenization outcomes, but the rejection happens before the result can be properly processed.

Payment method ID changes after successful tokenization
After adding a new payment method through my gateway, the webhook response contains a modified identifier that doesn't match what the provider originally assigned. This breaks my integration because I rely on that exact ID for future transactions.

Webhook processing fails with cryptic error on incomplete card data
When a payment gateway submits card details with missing digit information, the webhook processing fails with an unexpected error. The system attempts to process the missing values incorrectly, producing a confusing error instead of a clear message about what's missing. This happens specifically for credit card digit fields.

Address object modified in place during obfuscation
When I pass an address to the obfuscation utility for safe logging, the original address object gets permanently modified. After the call, the customer's name and other fields are already partially hidden even though I only intended the returned value to be obscured.

Transaction sort descriptions are unclear
When viewing available sort options for transactions, the descriptions for sorting by creation or modification date don't clearly explain what each option does. I expected them to specify whether they refer to the payment creation date or the transaction record date.

No channel filter when sorting transactions
When sorting transactions, there's no way to specify which channel to filter by. Other sorting inputs like products and vouchers include a channel argument, but the transaction sorting interface doesn't.

Reordering product attribute values produces scrambled positions
When I reorder attribute values on a product in the admin panel, the new positions don't stick — after saving and reloading, the values jump back to their original order. The issue seems to appear most often when the product has multiple attributes with several values each.

Reordering attributes for one product type shifts positions in another
When I assign the same attribute to two different product types and reorder it within one type's configuration, its position in the other type's list also changes unexpectedly. I expected each product type to maintain independent ordering.

Payment shows as captured but funds never received
When I capture a payment through the admin panel, it displays as successfully captured, but the money never arrives in my Stripe account. I later found out the card was declined. I expected the system to show a failure so I could retry with another payment method.

Page type limit ignored in reference types query
When querying for page types associated with an attribute using a limit parameter, the response returns all referenced page types instead of respecting the specified limit. For example, setting a limit of five page types returns all eight that are referenced by the attribute.

Referenced product types change between requests
When I query for the first five product types linked to an attribute, the returned product types vary from one request to the next even though nothing has changed in the system. I expected the same five product types each time.

Email notifications fail when template file is missing
When the system attempts to send an email notification, it crashes with a file not found error if the default template file doesn't exist at the expected location. This prevents all email notifications from being sent, including order confirmations and password resets. I expected the system to handle missing template files gracefully rather than causing a complete failure.

Dates in order confirmation emails always show day-month-year regardless of store locale
When I set up my store for a US audience, the order confirmation emails still display dates as DD-MM-YYYY instead of MM-DD-YYYY. Other formatted values like prices respect the store's language setting, but email dates are stuck in one fixed format. I expected dates to adapt to the locale just like prices do.

Address displays incorrectly in confirmation emails
The shipping address in my order confirmation has my first and last name merged into the street address line, and there are extra blank lines that weren't there before. This only happens when the same address data is used in multiple sections of the email.

Webhook fires when activating an already-active app
When I activate an app that is already enabled, the system still dispatches a status-changed webhook to all connected endpoints. I expected no notification to be sent since the app's state did not actually change.

Status changed webhook fires on already-active app
When I activate an app that is already enabled, the system still sends a status changed webhook to all registered endpoints. My integrations receive duplicate activation notifications unnecessarily.

Cannot filter export files by username
When I try to find my export files using my username in the filter, nothing comes back even though I know I created those exports. The filter seems to only match against first name, last name, and email address, but not the username itself which is what I normally use to identify myself.

User filter returns no results for valid email
When I filter export files by a user's email address, the filter returns zero results even though that user has created exports. Searching by app name works fine, but searching by user email never matches any records.

Public metadata not saved when updating my address
When I update my address through the account settings and include custom metadata, the metadata is silently dropped. The address fields save correctly, but any metadata I added disappears after the update completes.

Notification appears successful but never sends when a plugin is specified
When I trigger an external notification and include a specific plugin ID, the mutation returns success, but the notification never reaches its destination. If I omit the plugin ID and let the system use the default, the notification arrives normally. I expected the mutation to reject an invalid or inactive plugin ID upfront rather than pretending everything worked.

Permission denied when triggering notifications despite managing orders
I tried to send an external notification for several customer orders using the notification feature in the dashboard. The request was rejected with a permission denied error. I am able to view, fulfill, and process these orders without any issues, so I expected this notification action to work as well. I'm not sure what additional role or permission I need to request from my administrator.

Tax rate multiplied by 100 causing massively inflated charges
When the system calculates taxes for discounted items, the tax rate gets applied 100 times too high. An order with a 23 percent tax rate results in charges that are roughly 24 times the original price instead of 1.23 times. This occurs during checkout when reconciling discounted prices with the base price's tax calculation.

Promotion date validation error always targets end date
When I set a start date that falls after the end date, the mutation returns an error on the end date field instead of the start date, making it confusing to identify which field needs fixing.

Ended notification fires after adjusting end date of already-expired promotion
When I update a promotion that already ended by changing its end date to another past date, the system sends a new "promotion ended" webhook even though the promotion was already inactive. I expected the notification to only fire when the promotion actually transitions from active to ended.

Promotion restarted notification not sent after date extension
When a promotion that previously ended is updated with a new end date extending into the future, no start notification is sent even though the promotion is effectively restarting. The system remembers the previous ended notification and skips sending a new start one.

Image with one oversized dimension passes size validation
When I upload an image that exceeds the maximum allowed size on only one dimension—for example, 150 pixels wide by 50 pixels tall when the maximum is 100 pixels—the upload succeeds instead of being rejected. Both dimensions need to exceed the limit for the check to catch it, so a single oversized axis slips through.

Raw exception shown when uploading certain images
Uploading a specific image causes a raw exception to appear instead of a clean validation error message. The problem happens with images that have certain types of corrupted embedded metadata. I expected to see a user-friendly error message explaining that the file is invalid.

Deleted menu item returns null for nested fields like collection
After deleting a menu item via GraphQL, if the response includes nested fields such as collection or children, those fields are always null even when the deleted item had valid associations. I expected to see the actual linked data in the mutation response.

Deleting a menu item sometimes hangs and eventually times out
When deleting a menu item during busy periods, the request can hang for many seconds before completing or failing with a timeout. This happens more often when other menu modifications are running concurrently, even if they're unrelated items in the same menu tree.

Granted refund status stays stuck in pending after failed gift card refund
I requested a refund for a gift card payment, but the system returned an error (the payment gateway was unavailable). After that, the granted refund still shows as "pending" and never transitions to rejected or any other terminal state. Regular (non-gift-card) refunds update the status correctly even when the gateway call fails, but gift card refunds leave the granted refund frozen.

Refund request fails but transaction stays linked to granted refund
I requested a refund through the admin panel, but the payment gateway was unreachable so the request failed. Afterward, the granted refund shows a transaction item already assigned to it, even though no refund was actually processed. When I try again, the system says the refund is already in progress and blocks me from retrying.

Expected: If the refund request fails, the granted refund should not be linked to any transaction item, so I can retry without manual intervention.

Webhook notification sent even when app has not changed
When I update an existing app through the API without making any actual field changes, a webhook notification is still dispatched to all subscribers. For example, sending an update request that results in zero modified fields still triggers the app updated event. Downstream systems receive the notification and process it as if real changes occurred, causing unnecessary external calls and confusion.

App update fails with out-of-scope error despite having manage apps permission
When I try to update an existing app through the GraphQL API, the mutation fails with an out-of-scope error even though my account has the manage apps permission. This happens specifically when updating the app's configuration or permissions. I expected the mutation to succeed since I have the required permission level.
